info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Support Tickets Reopens-v2-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Reopening API allows users to retrieve a list of support tickets that have been marked for reopening. This functionality is essential for customer service teams and operations officers who need to keep track of unresolved or re-emerging issues. By utilizing this API, teams can efficiently monitor the status of reopened tickets, ensuring timely follow-ups and enhancing customer satisfaction. Typical consumers include support agents and business analysts who analyze ticket trends for continuous improvement.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to reopen a previously resolved or closed ticket in the system. Use this operation when you need to address ongoing issues or further inquiries related to this ticket.

requestBody.description: Request body for reopening a ticket. This should include the necessary details required to identify the ticket that is to be reopened.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the reopened ticket details.

ListSupportTicketsReopensRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the operation to reopen tickets. It is expected to contain a string value.

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the ticket.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the ticket.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Details about the audit of the operation.

ListSupportTicketsReopensResponse_200.description: The response schema for the ticket reopening operation.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the ticket.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the ticket was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Audit details for the ticket operation.

schema.description: The total time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
